title: Hired 3 marketing agencies in 2 years — all terrible. What am I doing wrong?

linkedin_ad.text:
Spent $57K on 3 marketing agencies in 2 years. Got 12 signed cases.

That's $4,750 per case.

All three failed because they optimized vanity metrics instead of what actually matters: signed cases.

Before you hire your next agency, ask:

1. How do you define a lead? (If they say clicks, run.)
2. What's my cost per signed case? (If they don't know, run.)
3. Can I access all accounts? (If no, run.)

Good agencies welcome accountability. Bad ones hide behind impressions.
linkedin_ad.headline: Why Your Marketing Agency Failed (And How to Spot the Next One)
